name: Quarters, Luxury
description:
This suite features separate rooms to house a number of creatures equal to half the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the **[Starship Size Suite Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Suite%20Capacity)** table. Each room comes fully furnished and includes its own refresher station.
When a creature completes a long rest involving this suite, they regain all spent Hit Dice, instead of only half, and their exhaustion level is reduced by 2, instead of only 1.
